title: Volvo starts training wheeled AEON humanoids at its Ghent plant
summary: Volvo Cars has begun training Hexagon Robotics' AEON humanoids at its Ghent plant, the first Volvo factory to try them. Staff are teaching the 1.65-metre, 60-kilogram wheeled robot by imitation, starting with placing components into two fixtures; payload is 10 kilograms and top speed 2.4 metres per second. A larger pilot with more units follows in the first half of 2027, with the aim of using the robots in real production from mid-2027. Volvo frames the target as repetitive, ergonomically difficult work alongside existing automation.
